A line-break-only emphasis inside a table cell still separates the words on either side

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<table><tr><td><strong>Alpha</strong><em><br></em>Beta</td></tr></table>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
